description: Frozen before ranking. Compares raw and html-v1 extraction on the same seven-file synthetic corpus. Labels come directly from fixture contents; file rank is authoritative and passage criteria are advisory.

corpus.scope: Behavioral fixtures derived from the supplied freezedry-helper examples; not representative of arbitrary saved websites and not evidence of Mozilla Readability parity. No remote resource is fetched and no script executes.

fixed_settings.note: Planned values only. A run's frozen-input-manifest.json must record authoritative resolved settings, exact git/package revisions, corpus and query hashes, model-file hashes, extraction strategies, diagnostics, chunk counts, and timings before search begins. Both arms differ only by text extraction.

metrics.no_answer_handling: Record top groups and scores for inspection only; do not invent a similarity cutoff or automatic absence judgment.
metrics.content_audit: Report preservation criteria separately from boilerplate exclusions. Neither output size nor an advisory string check overrides file rank.
